items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: So your father and your brother Richard were already doing music. Yes. And that’s what I heard since I was quite young.

ctx.x: And trying to play in their style in a way, and then you hear the other instrumentalists who play behind them and what they do.
So your father and your brother Richard were already doing music.
Yes. And that’s what I heard since I was quite young. I heard my father playing along with his records ever since I was born, and also practicing the various etudes and concertos and stuff.
